name: pqfms
description: Patient Queue and Flow Management System for outpatient queue and patient-flow operations.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && python -m pip install -r analytics_service/requirements.txt
scripts.lint: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend test && npm run test:analytics
